card.name: "Of" before serious disease outcomes
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after nouns like risk, likelihood or presence, where a serious condition comes next (e.g. malignancy, serious infection). Also "out" in "rule out" before a disease.

modes.label: Risk or likelihood of
modes.description: "of" after risk or likelihood, leading into a serious outcome.
modes.example: as there is a risk<< of>> serious bacterial infections.

modes.label: Presence of malignancy
modes.description: "of" after presence in warnings that symptom relief does not exclude gastric cancer.
modes.example: does not preclude the presence<< of>> gastric malignancy.

modes.label: Rule out
modes.description: "out" in "rule out" ahead of a serious diagnosis.
modes.example: appropriate measures should be conducted to rule<< out>> malignancy.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words for severe or fatal outcomes such as murder, homicide, suicide and lethal.
card.plain: It fires on the small word after "risk" or "presence" when a grave diagnosis or outcome is about to be named.
